title: Grateful Dead Live at Richmond Coliseum on 1985-11-01
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes (Taper's Section); Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Stunning audience-sourced recording captures a lightning‑quick, high‑energy performance that feels like dancing in the arena.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this tape for its remarkable sound quality – an open, arena‑like audience mix that rivals many soundboard releases. The show itself is described as fast‑paced and exhilarating, delivering a palpable sense of human connection despite no specific song highlights being called out. Overall it’s presented as a must‑listen for anyone seeking the live Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review overwhelmingly positive about both performance and audio, but limited detail on specific songs or musicians keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes a stunningly open soundstage that makes the listener feel present in the arena; clear and immersive for an audience tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as lightning‑quick and energetic throughout, creating a continuous feeling of excitement and connection.
